rv.q: Invictus Theatre’s intimate, bare-bones modern-dress staging of Hamlet is storefront Shakespeare at its best.
Invictus Theatre’s modern-dress production of the Bard’s 1601 script succeeds in making the language clear and forceful, with careful direction by Charles Askenaizer, who also stars as Hamlet.
This excellent production of Hamlet by Invictus Theatre demonstrates yet again why Chicago storefront theatre is known throughout the country.
The Invictus Theatre Company’s intense, intimate Hamlet is brave and a little crazy, but, in the end, what makes it work is its humanity.
He's not alone in delivering a multi-faceted and riveting performance, in this writer's view.
There are not enough words in the English language to describe Charles Askenaizer in his role as the prince of Denmark and as director of the production.
The Invictus Theatre Company production of Shakespeare’s HAMLET is the opening production in its fifth season of plays.
